cards.title: Borrowed Authority
cards.instruction: Project confident authority while quietly working to keep everyone cooperative. Your confidence depends on their cooperation.

cards.title: Make the Second Step First
cards.instruction: Get them to accept a small consequence that makes the larger risky action feel already underway.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: We'll book the climbing lesson now. Put five pounds down; we can decide about the wall tomorrow.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I haven't agreed to climb anything.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Just reserve the place. I'll put five down beside yours so we both have something to lose.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: You have to come in with me. No dropping me at the door.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'll meet you at the climbing wall. Shall I book us adjacent lockers while the payment page is open?

reason: Replace the invented refund condition with shared deposit risk and B demand for companionship, then use that consent to advance the booking further.
